segments.summary: Reviewed all 146 core lines defining coordination EventRecords, redb read-model projections, and compatibility/debug mirror exports. The authority and migration direction is clear, but executable payload schemas, per-event invariants, projection checkpoint and transaction semantics, mirror failure recovery, operational bounds, GUI truth states, and falsifiable acceptance oracles are deferred or absent.
